# Modified 2026-11-22: extracted the verbs used by "Apprenez le français !" (simple tenses and
# masculine singular past participle), regrouped by tense and person, alternative spellings
# joined with "/" with the traditional spelling first. Corrected: inclure/occlure past participle
# (inclus, occlus), "il tait" (taire), and the present of enamourer/énamourer (enamoure).
# Columns: infinitive, tense (present imparfait futur cond subj ps, or pp), person 0-5 (je..ils, "-" for pp), forms
